minor.issue: UserOut response_model does NOT include `phone_verified` field even though earn_and_tools sets it in db.users on phone confirm. Frontend cannot read phone_verified from /auth/me without server-side changes. Suggest adding `phone_verified: bool = False` to UserOut model (server.py line ~53).

action_items: MINOR BACKEND: Add `phone_verified: bool = False` to UserOut model (server.py line ~53) so /auth/me exposes verification status to the frontend without a second DB read. earn_and_tools already writes phone_verified=true on the user doc.

OPTIONAL POLISH: Migrate shadow* → boxShadow, style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents across new components (AdModal, MiniPropertyCard, BoostSheet, earn.tsx StyleSheets) to silence React Native Web warnings.
OPTIONAL: Investigate the React 19 element.ref console error from @gorhom/bottom-sheet — verify installed version is React 19-compatible.

SEED DATA: Consider seeding 1 or 2 properties owned by demo@amass.africa so /agent-dashboard Listings tab renders a listing-{id} row with a boost-{id} chip — this would allow full end-to-end BoostSheet UI verification in Playwright (currently the flow is backend-verified only).
REMINDER: Phone OTP (accepts 123456), Paystack/Flutterwave payments, Cloudinary/S3 media are still MOCKED. Ad admin approval is auto-active for MVP.
critical_code_review_comments: ads.py /ads/next: server-side cooldown check runs BEFORE reading `exclude` and `hidden` — an authed user in cooldown gets {ad:null, reason:'cooldown'} even if they have not seen the currently-eligible ad. This is correct per spec but means the client MUST call /ads/track {event:'impression'} for the cooldown window to actually start (client-driven telemetry). Consider auto-registering an impression when /ads/next returns a non-null ad, otherwise cooldown never triggers for buggy clients that forget to track.

ads.py test_track_impression_and_click_increment_counters shows counters DO increment (impressions/clicks); however /ads/next for an authed user immediately hits cooldown on the very next call, so verifying the counter bump via /ads/next required an unauth session. Fine, just document.

earn_and_tools.py /agent/ai/parse-search does no auth — endpoint is intentionally public (free UX helper) but there is no rate-limit or Emergent-LLM quota guard. Anonymous abusive traffic could burn tokens on your LLM key. Recommend a per-IP rate-limit or requiring auth.

earn_and_tools.py /earn/tasks streak walk uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc).date()` per iteration — fine for MVP but breaks around midnight UTC for Nigeria (GMT+1). Consider computing streak in the user's timezone.

server.py POST /properties awards 40 tokens even when property has empty images, no city, no state — no minimum-quality gate. Rate-limited to 5/day which is fine, but a spammer can still farm 200 tokens/day by uploading throwaway listings.

ads.py Ad Pydantic model default expires_at=now — every field default is evaluated at import time (default_factory=lambda: datetime.now(...)) which is correct, but Ad(...) without an override would expire immediately. The create_ad handler correctly overrides expires_at based on tier days. Good.

Recommend adding a cleanup script that drops users with email prefix TEST_ and their token_transactions/wallets/otp_sessions/referral_uses/lead_unlocks/advertisements.
